generated.title: Excessive use of first-person singular "I" throughout Objective and Schedule
generated.description: The writing style guideline explicitly states to avoid "I." The proposal uses "I" (first-person singular) approximately 16 times, predominantly in the Objective section (pages 4–7) and the Schedule (page 7). The student should restructure sentences to use the platform, the system, or other concrete actors as subjects (e.g., "The platform will build…" or simply "The thesis builds a platform…") rather than repeatedly foregrounding the author as the agent. The guideline permits "we" sparingly for the thesis approach, but "I" is to be avoided entirely.

locations.quote: **I** will build a platform on which any member of the chair requests time-limited access to any resource, a maintainer decides, and the access ends on its own.
**I** follow the object-oriented software engineering method of Bruegge and Dutoit, and Figure 1 shows the actors and use cases of the platform as a use case diagram in the Unified Modeling Language.
**I** pursue four objectives:
**I** will replace the flat list of hosts and channels with a resource tree whose inner nodes are folders and whose leaves each carry a binding to one target system.
**I** will store the tree with a transitive-closure table of ancestor–descendant pairs and cap the fan-out, so that an approval on the root never reaches the whole infrastructure by accident.

**I** will define one connector contract that validates a binding, grants and revokes access, and optionally lists the current members, and **I** will implement the keycloak-group, slack-channel, github-team, and webhook connectors on it.
**I** measure extensibility by the size of the change that the webhook connector needs after **I** freeze the framework.
**I** will build declarative request forms whose fields, visibility conditions, and rules turn answers into requests for a resource path, a level, and a duration.

**I** will therefore split the approval: in the review step, the resource owner records a decision without changing Keycloak, and in the grant step, the super admin sets membership and expiry atomically, in bulk for a vetted queue.
**I** will compare the manual administrative actions and the time to working access with the current process.
**I** will attach a recertification interval to each resource, which its descendants inherit, and open a campaign whenever the interval elapses.
The thesis runs from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027, and **I** divide it into iterations of two to four weeks.
each item names the objective it serves and the outcome that **I** demonstrate.
